card.name: Number right after a colon
card.fires_on: The word or number right after a colon inside a compact label, such as a citation year:page, a ratio, or min:sec. It fires on the item that completes the pair.

modes.label: Citation page after year
modes.description: A page or chapter number following a colon after a year in a reference.

modes.label: Ratio or time pair
modes.description: The second part of a ratio or time unit after a colon.

modes.label: Colon inside a compound
modes.description: A word after a colon that joins two terms, sometimes splitting a word.

card.plain: It marks the item that comes right after a colon in a short pair, like a page number after a year or the seconds in min:sec.
